blocks.description: A map of resource CID string to the (compressed) content bytes of that resource. Used together with `resources` when a facet ships its MASL content inline.

enabled.description: Whether the facet is enabled or not

favourite.description: Whether the facet is favourited (shown at the top) or not. Some facets may be more important to the user than others.

kind.description: A facet is by default interactive, but headless 'prelude' facets may also be created, these run before any main interactive facet is loaded.

resources.description: The MASL `resources` map of a tile, keyed by path. The facet record itself is the MASL manifest; the `/` resource holds the facet's HTML. Its `src` CID points at a block in `blocks` (inline) or in the CAR when loaded from a `.tile` file.

uri.description: An optional URI that points at the facet; can be used to update this artifact
